normalize_cameras_optical: normalize pytorch3d cameras so optical axes intersect at origin with unit average distance
compute_optical_axis_intersection: compute the intersection point of multiple camera optical axes using skew line geometry
intersect_skew_line_groups: find the closest intersection point for groups of skew lines in high dimensions
first_camera_transform: transform all cameras so the first camera is aligned to the origin
normalize_Trans: normalize camera translation vectors by their average magnitude with clamped scale
